basic_info.description: Views for miles! This contemporary townhouse condo showcases memorable views of the Bay, East Bay hills and Mt Diablo, Port of Oakland, and San Francisco's dramatic skyline. Stretch out over three levels with a private top floor primary suite. You will appreciate the great closet space and modern open layout. Lower level with two bedrooms, bath, and laundry.These bedrooms also have terrific closet space. The main level is highlighted with soaring double height ceilings and a view deck. All levels have been upgraded with wide-plank wood flooring. The kitchen features sleek white solid surface counters and Whirlpool stainless steel appliance set. Life is quiet and private with no neighbors above or below you. Secure attached garage is notably spacious for your car and various hobby interests. An up and coming location close to Heron's Head and India Basin shoreline parks, public transit, freeways, and the uber trendy dogpatch neighborhood just to the north. Get your coffee and a fab morning bun at Cafe Alma just a few blocks away. Enjoy a spa day at Archimedes Banya around the corner.
